results.name: knowledge_documents
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE knowledge_documents (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_sources(id),
  owner_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  url TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  published_at TEXT,
  fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified_at TEXT,
  valid_until TEXT,
  academic_year TEXT,
  campus_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (campus_scope IN ('university_town', 'baiyun', 'all', 'online', 'unknown')),
  data_domain TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (data_domain IN ('official_policy', 'campus_announcements', 'approved_life_experience', 'user_private')),
  review_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (review_status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  lifecycle_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (lifecycle_status IN ('active', 'expired', 'superseded', 'withdrawn')),
  superseded_by TEXT REFERENCES knowledge_documents(id), version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, publication_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(publication_status IN('draft','published','withdrawn')), workflow_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(workflow_status IN('pending','approved','returned','rejected')), candidate_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'knowledge' CHECK(candidate_kind IN('knowledge','event')), extracted_fields_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(extracted_fields_json)), source_updated_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT, content_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(content_revision>=0), input_hash TEXT CHECK(input_hash IS NULL OR length(input_hash)=64), approved_content_revision INTEGER, approved_input_hash TEXT, content_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK(content_type IN('event','notice','policy','guide','news','unknown')), rights_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK(rights_scope IN('metadata_only','excerpt_and_link','licensed_full_text','no_collection','unknown')), publisher TEXT, summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(summary)<=500), radar_category TEXT CHECK(radar_category IS NULL OR radar_category IN('lecture','culture_sports','competition','education_career','academic_research','scholarship_opportunity','campus_notice')), knowledge_category TEXT CHECK(knowledge_category IS NULL OR knowledge_category IN('academic_affairs','campus_life','administrative_services','scholarship_policy','education_career','research_innovation')), body_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK(body_status IN('unknown','not_provided','partial','complete')), body_format TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'plain' CHECK(body_format IN('plain','reading_html')),
  CHECK ((data_domain = 'user_private' AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (data_domain <> 'user_private' AND owner_user_id IS NULL)),
  UNIQUE(url, content_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE knowledge_chunks (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  vector_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  start_offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (start_offset >= 0),
  end_offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (end_offset >= start_offset),
  page_number INTEGER CHECK (page_number IS NULL OR page_number > 0)
, snapshot_version INTEGER, content_revision INTEGER, input_hash TEXT)

CREATE TABLE content_index_invalidations (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_documents(id), version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN('pending','processed')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
)

results.name: document_article_analysis
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE document_article_analysis (
 document_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES knowledge_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 content_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,classifier_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 input_digest TEXT NOT NULL,projection_hash TEXT NOT NULL,processed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 primary_destination TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(primary_destination IN('radar','knowledge','unknown')),
 radar_category TEXT,knowledge_category TEXT,has_registration INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(has_registration IN(0,1)),
 analysis_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(analysis_json)),
 CHECK((primary_destination='unknown' AND radar_category IS NULL AND knowledge_category IS NULL)
  OR (primary_destination='radar' AND radar_category IS NOT NULL AND knowledge_category IS NULL)
  OR (primary_destination='knowledge' AND knowledge_category IS NOT NULL AND radar_category IS NULL))
)

results.name: console_article_classifications
results.sql:
CREATE VIEW console_article_classifications AS
 SELECT d.id AS document_id,
  CASE WHEN m.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN m.radar_category IS NOT NULL THEN 'radar' ELSE 'knowledge' END
       WHEN a.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.primary_destination
       WHEN d.radar_category IS NOT NULL THEN 'radar' WHEN d.knowledge_category IS NOT NULL THEN 'knowledge' ELSE 'unknown' END AS primary_destination,
  CASE WHEN m.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.radar_category WHEN a.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.radar_category ELSE d.radar_category END AS radar_category,
  CASE WHEN m.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.knowledge_category WHEN a.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.knowledge_category ELSE d.knowledge_category END AS knowledge_category,
  COALESCE(a.has_registration,0) AS has_registration,a.analysis_json,a.classifier_version,
  CASE WHEN m.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'manual' WHEN a.document_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'automatic' ELSE 'legacy' END AS classification_origin
 FROM knowledge_documents d
 LEFT JOIN document_article_analysis a ON a.document_id=d.id AND a.content_revision=d.content_revision AND a.input_hash=d.input_hash
 LEFT JOIN document_classification_overrides m ON m.document_id=d.id
 WHERE d.owner_user_id IS NULL AND d.data_domain<>'user_private'

SELECT c.primary_destination,s.channel_type,count(*) n FROM knowledge_documents d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id=d.source_id JOIN console_article_classifications c ON c.document_id=d.id WHERE d.owner_user_id IS NULL AND d.data_domain<>'user_private' AND s.console_managed=1 GROUP BY c.primary_destination,s.channel_type

SELECT d.rights_scope,d.body_status,s.channel_type,count(*) n,sum(CASE WHEN p.source_id IS NOT NULL AND p.expires_at_ms<=CAST((julianday('now')-2440587.5)*86400000 AS INTEGER) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) expired_policy FROM knowledge_documents d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id=d.source_id LEFT JOIN source_collection_policies p ON p.source_id=s.id WHERE d.owner_user_id IS NULL AND d.data_domain<>'user_private' AND s.console_managed=1 GROUP BY d.rights_scope,d.body_status,s.channel_type
